statement: Unified File → Import routes typed sequence, map, trajectory, topology, and SMILES sources to dedicated viewers while preserving source semantics and never fabricating coordinates.
limits: DCD/XTC/TRR coordinate frame decoding is not enabled; only validated metadata/header status is shown.
Topology viewers do not fabricate coordinates or pair PSF/PRMTOP with trajectories.
Online providers require network access and explicit identifiers.
